title: Re-contextualizing Fairness in NLP: The Case of India

bias_targets.methodology: Perturbation sensitivity analysis on sentiment scores using regional identity terms (demonyms) and evaluating masked language models for top-K predictions of stereotypical trait associations.

Perturbation sensitivity analysis measuring shifts in sentiment scores when counterfactually replacing caste-related identity terms in sentences.
